'''Rheshalva Interstellar Armaments''', also known as '''Rheshalva Arms''', was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] arms-manufacturing company founded around [[6000 BBY/Legends|6000 BBY]]. They were notable as one of the few Rodian weapons manufacturers to have production facilities off of Rodia.<ref name="NEGTW" /> They produced [[molytex]] [[Techstaff|tech staffs]].<ref name="Molytex">{{TORcite|Rheshalva Arms Molytex Tech Staff}}</ref>
